results.title: r/socialanxiety on Reddit: I Wish There Was Social Anxiety Dating App
results.snippet: It’s weird but when I know someone else has social anxiety I relax a lot more and actually seem pretty confident. Something about someone I’m talking to knowing the struggle just makes me feel more at ease I guess. ... Finally someone said this I thought about this thing ig 2 years before and since then I've felt that there should've been such an app I really wish such an app exists It would be extremely helpful for us people with social anxiety
